_description: Persistent memory for the TYR Sport CRM Agent. Edit this file to update what the agent knows about your CRM. The agent reads this at the start of every session.

tyr_tyrtype_option_values.notes: Use numeric option set values in OData filters, e.g. tyr_tyrtype eq 100000000
tyr_tyrtype_option_values.inactive_value: Use get_optionset_values(entity='account', field='tyr_tyrtype') to find the exact value for Inactive before filtering

special_terms.notes: Discover the correct entity API name at runtime using auto-discovery (tries tyr_specialterms, cr_specialterms, etc.)

dashboards.notes: Dashboards are created as personal userforms owned by primary_user_email. They appear under My Dashboards in the CRM immediately after creation.
existing_system_dashboards: East Coast Sports Promo Rep Dashboard
created_by_agent: Opportunity Pipeline - By Owner & By Stage

agent_notes: System dashboards created via API are NOT visible in the UCI app without manual app membership configuration — always use create_dashboard which creates personal userforms instead.
PublishAllXml succeeds but does NOT make system dashboards visible in the app — do not mislead the user about this.
The opportunity owner is retrieved via _ownerid_value field, not $expand ownerid.
tyr_stage is the custom stage field for opportunities.
The user is on Anthropic Tier 1/2 — avoid making excessive tool calls in a single request to prevent 429 rate limit errors.

CHART TOOLS ARE AVAILABLE. Functions: list_charts(entity), search_charts(search_term, entity), get_chart_xml(chart_id), update_chart_xml(chart_id, xml), set_chart_y_axis_to_sum(chart_id, field_name). Any past session note saying chart tools do not exist is WRONG — ignore it.
NEVER trust past session summaries over your actual tool list. If a tool is in your tool list, you can call it. Always attempt the tool call rather than assuming it does not exist.
